stages.title: Selected versioned assemblies
stages.description: Use a prior selected input panel only after hash verification. No fabricated assemblies, species panels, or added Enterococcus records.

stages.title: Annotated proteomes
stages.description: Carry forward only annotated proteomes derived from the selected assemblies.

stages.title: Conserved marker families
stages.description: Identify conserved marker families before downstream tree building.

stages.title: Separate alignments
stages.description: Align homologues of each marker separately, trim unreliable positions, then concatenate in fixed order with recorded partitions. Preserve every source protein accession.

stages.title: IQ-TREE host tree
stages.description: Infer a maximum-likelihood host tree from the concatenated conserved-marker protein alignment with model, seed, support and rooting evidence. R-M genes do not define this topology.

stages.title: Independent R-M detection
stages.description: Independently inspect ordered per-replicon proteins plus GFF/GenBank coordinates with locked DefenseFinder models. Failure/missing is not absence. Raw hits stay unreviewed.

stages.title: Locus review
stages.description: Review loci manually with explicit evidence links and human approval gates.

stages.title: Four rings
stages.description: Join tree tips by exact assembly ID to four independent R-M type columns: I, II/IIG, III, IV. C is computational; U unreviewed; P requires manual curation. Experimental evidence is separate.
